name: NHC Foods Limited
about: NHC Foods Limited engages in the provision of whole and ground spices products in India and internationally. The company offers spices, oil seeds, rice, dry fruits, cereal and grains, dehydrated products, chickpeas, herbs, coffee, sugar, and other foodstuffs, as well as lentils, pulses, grains, agri-products and assorted food products. It offers its products under the Indibite and SAAZ brand names. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as NHC Industries Pvt. Ltd. NHC Foods Limited was founded in 1960 and is based in Mumbai, India.
